title: Anchor Tag
body: `` — the hyperlink element, and arguably the thing that makes the web a web. ```html Products About Jump to reviews ``` The `href` attribute is the destination [[URL]]. It can be absolute (a full URL), relative to the current path, or a fragment starting with `#`, which scrolls to an element on the current page without any network request — the fragment never leaves your machine. Other useful attributes: `target="_blank"` opens in a new tab (pair it with `rel="noopener"`), and `download` prompts a save instead of a navigation. Clicking one issues a GET request; to send data you want a [[Form Tag]] instead. See [[HTML]].
